name: Granite Falls (United States)
description: Two shades of green divided by a white-outlined mountain peak, with CITY OF GRANITE FALLS in white on the lower part.
history: Granite Falls is a city in Snohomish County, Washington. Flags of the World records this flag from a 2019 photograph and an earlier flag, designed in 2002 by high-school student Ryan Reed, showing the sun behind Mount Pilchuck.

features.role: mountain peak outlined in white, for Mount Pilchuck
